full_list.title_en: Dirac Representation for Lattice Spin Operators: Spin-1/2 and Spin-1 cases
full_list.title_zh: 格子自旋算子的狄拉克表示：Spin-1/2 和 Spin-1 情况
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2504.11917v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a quantum representation of lattice spin operators (LSOs) by mapping quantum spins to their classical analogues for spin values S=1/2 and S=1. The resulting Dirac (bra--ket) forms are derived from the structure of binary and ternary digit distributions in non-negative integers. colorblue The construction requires only an enumeration of the lattice sites and is therefore independent on the spatial dimension and lattice geometry. colorblack Analytical expressions for extracting the jth bit or trit of an integer without performing an explicit binary or ternary decomposition are obtained. colorblueAs an application of the representation, colorblack we analyze the one-dimensional spin-1/2 XXZ Heisenberg model with open boundaries in a magnetic field in both absence (uniform magnetic field) and presence of disorder (random magnetic field). In the absence of disorder (clean system), we demonstrate that the corresponding eigenvalue problem can be reduced to a tight-binding problem on a graph. For the isotropic case, this is solved analytically without resorting to any spinless transformation or the Bethe Ansatz. In the presence of disorder, a convergent perturbation theory is elaborated. Our analytical results are benchmarked against exact diagonalization for systems up to K≤ 18 spins. These computations exploit the global U(1) symmetry to block-diagonalize the Hamiltonian and the spin-inversion symmetry to further decompose the zero-magnetization sector. Quantitative agreement between analytical and numerical results is observed.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们通过将量子自旋映射到自旋值 S=1/2 和 S=1 的经典类似物，引入了晶格自旋算子 (LSO) 的量子表示。由此产生的狄拉克 (bra--ket) 形式源自非负整数的二进制和三元数字分布结构。 colorblue 该构造仅需要枚举晶格位置，因此独立于空间维度和晶格几何形状。 colorblack 获得用于提取整数的第 j 位或 trit 而不执行显式二元或三元分解的解析表达式。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过将量子自旋映射到自旋值 S=1/2 和 S=1 的经典类似物，引入了晶格自旋算子 (LSO) 的量子表示。由此产生的狄拉克 (bra--ket) 形式源自非负整数的二进制和三元数字分布结构。 colorblue 该构造仅需要枚举晶格位置，因此独立于空间维度和晶格几何形状。 colorblack 获得用于提取整数的第 j 位或 trit 而不执行显式二元或三元分解的解析表达式。 colorblue作为 colorblack 表示的应用，我们分析了在不存在（均匀磁场）和存在无序（随机磁场）的情况下在磁场中具有开放边界的一维自旋 1/2 XXZ 海森堡模型。在没有无序（干净系统）的情况下，我们证明相应的特征值问题可以简化为图上的紧束缚问题。对于各向同性情况，可以通过分析求解，无需借助任何无自旋变换或 Bethe Ansatz。在存在无序的情况下，详细阐述了收敛微扰理论。我们的分析结果以 K≤ 18 次旋转的系统的精确对角化为基准。这些计算利用全局 U(1) 对称性对哈密顿量进行块对角化，并利用自旋反转对称性进一步分解零磁化扇区。观察到分析结果和数值结果之间的定量一致性。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Dirac Representation for Lattice Spin Operators: Spin-1/2 and Spin-1 cases》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Edge state reconstruction in proximitized graphene and its probe using RKKY interaction
full_list.title_zh: 利用 RKKY 相互作用重建邻近石墨烯及其探针的边缘状态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Proximity induced spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in graphene emerges when it is placed on a substrate, breaking sublattice symmetry and giving rise to staggered intrinsic SOC together with Rashba spin-orbit coupling. In zigzag graphene nanoribbons, this staggered SOC produces pseudohelical edge states exhibiting sublattice-locked rather than spin-locked helicity. We investigate the effect of a finite on-site potential, restricted to the edges of the ribbon, on these edge states. We find the inter-valley edge states undergo reconstruction and become purely intra-valley, exhibiting both spin and valley polarization. The charge conductance calculations fail to capture this reconstruction, since the number of transmitted channels remains unchanged. We show that the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) magnetic exchange interaction, between two magnetic impurities situated on the ribbon edge can be used to probe the shifted band dispersion, for both the uniform and staggered spin-orbit coupling. In the presence of strong intrinsic and Rashba SOC, the RKKY interaction becomes fully anisotropic. Both sublattice staggering and edge potential-induced reconstruction lead to distinct features in the RKKY interaction. We show that the RKKY interaction terms acquire faster oscillations as a function of the spatial separation between two magnetic impurities, in response to the edge state reconstruction, establishing it as an effective probe of the edge states. Additionally, the significant mismatch in the amplitudes of the DM term corresponding to the uniform and staggered SOC, can also act as a probe of the type of SOC.
full_list.abstract_zh: 当石墨烯放置在基板上时，就会出现石墨烯中的邻近诱导自旋轨道耦合（SOC），打破亚晶格对称性并与 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合一起产生交错的本征 SOC。在锯齿状石墨烯纳米带中，这种交错的 SOC 产生伪螺旋边缘态，表现出亚晶格锁定螺旋性，而不是自旋锁定螺旋性。我们研究了限制在带边缘的有限现场电势对这些边缘状态的影响。我们发现谷间边缘态经历重建并变成纯粹的谷内，表现出自旋和谷极化。电荷电导计算无法捕获这种重建，因为传输通道的数量保持不变。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 当石墨烯放置在基板上时，就会出现石墨烯中的邻近诱导自旋轨道耦合（SOC），打破亚晶格对称性并与 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合一起产生交错的本征 SOC。在锯齿状石墨烯纳米带中，这种交错的 SOC 产生伪螺旋边缘态，表现出亚晶格锁定螺旋性，而不是自旋锁定螺旋性。我们研究了限制在带边缘的有限现场电势对这些边缘状态的影响。我们发现谷间边缘态经历重建并变成纯粹的谷内，表现出自旋和谷极化。电荷电导计算无法捕获这种重建，因为传输通道的数量保持不变。我们表明，位于带边缘的两个磁性杂质之间的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 磁交换相互作用可用于探测均匀和交错自旋轨道耦合的移位能带色散。在存在强本征和 Rashba SOC 的情况下，RKKY 相互作用变得完全各向异性。亚晶格交错和边缘电势诱导重建都导致 RKKY 相互作用的独特特征。我们表明，RKKY 相互作用项随着两个磁性杂质之间的空间分离而获得更快的振荡，以响应边缘态重建，从而将其确立为边缘态的有效探针。此外，与均匀且交错的 SOC 相对应的 DM 项幅度的显着失配也可以充当 SOC 类型的探针。

full_list.title_en: Exciton superfluidity in two-dimensional bilayers at zero and high magnetic fields
full_list.title_zh: 零磁场和高磁场下二维双层中的激子超流动性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study interlayer exciton superfluidity versus layer separation in two-dimensional electron-hole bilayers at zero magnetic field and quantum Hall bilayers at total filling ν_T=1. Unscreened Hartree-Fock theory predicts coherence at every finite separation, with an energy scale decaying inversely with separation at large distances. We examine how screening, correlations, and spatial instabilities modify this prediction. At zero field, we solve the linearized gap equation with the full momentum and frequency dependence of the interaction screened within the random-phase approximation, without an imposed cutoff. The apparent plasmon enhancement of pairing in the ladder approximation is largely cancelled by the second-order crossed-rung correction. Static screening determines the leading pairing exponent in the controlled high-density limit at fixed separation. At large separation, the pairing scale falls exponentially with squared separation while the instability persists. Extending this result to fixed density assumes Fermi-liquid layers and higher-order dynamical corrections subleading to the static pairing interaction. At high field, we obtain an analytic uniform Hartree-Fock saddle point in the lowest Landau level, coherent at every finite separation. Within Hartree-Fock theory, its finite-wave-vector collective-mode instability favors an excitonic supersolid, distinguishing loss of spatial uniformity from loss of coherence. We conjecture that the quantum Hall bilayer evolves continuously toward weak pairing of composite fermions, with a scale far below the mean-field prediction at large separation. This suppression could produce an apparent critical separation at finite temperature without a ground-state quantum phase transition. The comparison separates the existence, energy scale, and spatial stability of interlayer coherence.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了零磁场下二维电子空穴双层和总填充 ν_T=1 下量子霍尔双层中的层间激子超流性与层分离的关系。未屏蔽的 Hartree-Fock 理论预测了每次有限分离时的相干性，能量尺度与大距离分离呈反比衰减。我们研究筛选、相关性和空间不稳定性如何修改这一预测。在零场处，我们求解线性间隙方程，其具有在随机相位近似内筛选的相互作用的完整动量和频率依赖性，而没有强加的截止。阶梯近似中配对的明显等离子体增强在很大程度上被二阶交叉梯级校正所抵消。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了零磁场下二维电子空穴双层和总填充 ν_T=1 下量子霍尔双层中的层间激子超流性与层分离的关系。未屏蔽的 Hartree-Fock 理论预测了每次有限分离时的相干性，能量尺度与大距离分离呈反比衰减。我们研究筛选、相关性和空间不稳定性如何修改这一预测。在零场处，我们求解线性间隙方程，其具有在随机相位近似内筛选的相互作用的完整动量和频率依赖性，而没有强加的截止。阶梯近似中配对的明显等离子体增强在很大程度上被二阶交叉梯级校正所抵消。静态筛选确定固定间隔下受控高密度限制内的主要配对指数。在大分离时，配对规模随着分离的平方呈指数下降，同时不稳定性仍然存在。将此结果扩展到固定密度假设费米液体层和高阶动态校正导致静态配对相互作用。在高场下，我们在最低 Landau 能级中获得了一个解析均匀 Hartree-Fock 鞍点，在每个有限间隔处都是相干的。在哈特里-福克理论中，其有限波矢量集体模式不稳定性有利于激子超固体，区分空间均匀性的损失和相干性的损失。我们推测，量子霍尔双层不断向复合费米子的弱配对演化，其规模远低于大分离时的平均场预测。这种抑制可以在有限温度下产生明显的临界分离，而无需基态量子相变。比较区分了层间相干性的存在、能量尺度和空间稳定性。

full_list.title_en: Gyrators for superconducting circuit design
full_list.title_zh: 用于超导电路设计的回转器
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22145v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Assuming only the solubility of Kirchhoff's laws, the conservation of energy, and the form of the constitutive relations, we present a flux-charge symmetric Hamiltonian formalism that always admits a symplectic reduction for nonsingular, well-posed circuits involving gyrators, inductors, and capacitors (LCG circuits) with arbitrary non-linearity. The formalism introduces a notion of circuit duality on non-linear non-reciprocal circuits and a family of point transformations that inserts, removes, and moves reciprocal elements across gyrators while preserving the Hamiltonian spectrum. With these transformations, we extend Tellegen's classic result that gyrators make reciprocal elements behave as their dual to non-linear reciprocal elements such as the Josephson junction and quantum phase slip. Furthermore, we present conditions under which non-reciprocal circuits can be transformed to dynamically equivalent reciprocal circuits.
full_list.abstract_zh: 仅假设基尔霍夫定律的可解性、能量守恒和本构关系的形式，我们提出了一种磁通荷对称哈密顿形式主义，该形式主义始终允许涉及具有任意非线性的回转器、电感器和电容器（LCG 电路）的非奇异、适定电路（LCG 电路）的辛约简。该形式主义引入了非线性非互易电路上的电路对偶性概念以及一系列点变换，这些点变换在回转器上插入、删除和移动互易元素，同时保留哈密顿谱。通过这些变换，我们扩展了特勒根的经典结果，即回转器使互易元件表现为对偶非线性互易元件，例如约瑟夫森结和量子相滑。

full_list.title_en: Low temperature thermodynamics of Sₑff=1/2 triangular lattice quantum spin liquid candidate TlYbS₂
full_list.title_zh: Sₑff=1/2三角晶格量子自旋液体候选TlYbS2的低温热力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11881v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Geometrically frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnets exhibit a delicate competition between magnetic order and quantum spin liquid (QSL) behavior, with the Yb-based delafossite family AYbX₂ providing a structurally clean platform for exploring this physics. Here, we report a comprehensive study of single-crystal TlYbS₂ using DC magnetization, AC susceptibility, electron spin resonance (ESR), and specific heat measurements extending from room temperature to the millikelvin regime. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms a trigonal Rbar3m structure comprising well-separated triangular layers of Yb³⁺ ions with no detectable site disorder. At zero field, a weak thermodynamic anomaly is observed near 530 mK, which may indicate the onset of a weakly ordered state similar to that reported in KYbSe₂. Below 300 mK, the zero-field magnetic specific heat follows Cᵣₘ ₘpropto T¹.⁸, close to a quadratic temperature dependence, in contrast to the linear temperature dependence reported for the sister compound TlYbSe₂, which has been described in terms of the interplay between spinons and thermally excited gauge-flux excitations. Magnetization and ESR measurements establish pronounced easy-plane magnetic anisotropy, with g_perp/g_parallel approx 6.9. The anomaly near 530 mK exhibits a strongly anisotropic response to magnetic field. For Hperp c, it remains visible up to approximately 2 T and continuously evolves toward a field-induced ordered phase above approximately 2.5 T, followed by a sequence of field-induced phases that includes a 1/3 magnetization plateau between approximately 5 and 8 T and full polarization near 17 T. In contrast, for Hparallel c, the anomaly weakens and is suppressed near 3 T, consistent with the recently reported confinement--deconfinement transition from an ordered state to a field-induced QSL.
full_list.abstract_zh: 几何挫败三角晶格反铁磁体表现出磁序和量子自旋液体 (QSL) 行为之间的微妙竞争，基于 Yb 的铜铁矿家族 AYbX2 为探索这种物理现象提供了一个结构干净的平台。在这里，我们报告了使用直流磁化、交流磁化率、电子自旋共振 (ESR) 以及从室温到毫开尔文范围的比热测量对单晶 TlYbS2 进行的综合研究。单晶 X 射线衍射证实了三角 Rbar3m 结构，包含分离良好的 Yb3+ 离子三角形层，没有可检测到的位点无序。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 几何挫败三角晶格反铁磁体表现出磁序和量子自旋液体 (QSL) 行为之间的微妙竞争，基于 Yb 的铜铁矿家族 AYbX2 为探索这种物理现象提供了一个结构干净的平台。在这里，我们报告了使用直流磁化、交流磁化率、电子自旋共振 (ESR) 以及从室温到毫开尔文范围的比热测量对单晶 TlYbS2 进行的综合研究。单晶 X 射线衍射证实了三角 Rbar3m 结构，包含分离良好的 Yb3+ 离子三角形层，没有可检测到的位点无序。在零场处，在 530 mK 附近观察到弱热力学异常，这可能表明类似于 KYbSe2 中报道的弱有序态的开始。在 300 mK 以下，零场磁比热遵循 Cᵣₘ ₘpropto T1.⁸，接近于二次温度依赖性，这与姊妹化合物 TlYbSe2 报告的线性温度依赖性相反，后者是根据自旋子和热激发规范通量激发之间的相互作用进行描述的。磁化强度和 ESR 测量建立了明显的易平面磁各向异性，g_perp/g_parallel 约为 6.9。 530 mK 附近的异常对磁场表现出强烈的各向异性响应。对于 Hperp c，它在高达约 2 T 时仍然可见，并持续向约 2.5 T 以上的场致有序相演化，随后是一系列场致相，其中包括约 5 到 8 T 之间的 1/3 磁化平台和接近 17 T 的完全极化。相反，对于 Hparallel c，异常减弱并在 3 T 附近受到抑制，这与最近报道的从有序态到无序态的限制-解除限制转变一致。场诱导的 QSL。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Non-equilibrium Muon Dynamics Imitating Fractional Spin Excitations in a Quantum Spin Chain
full_list.title_zh: 模拟量子自旋链中分数自旋激发的非平衡 μ 子动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional spin excitations in low-dimensional and frustrated magnets are commonly associated with sporadic spin fluctuations, as observed in quantum spin liquids, spin ices, and other complex magnetic states. In this study, we investigate the spin dynamics in the amplitude-modulated magnetic ground state of AgCuVO₄, a spin-1/2 chain compound with competing intrachain interactions, by muon spectroscopy. Our data reveal a Gaussian decay of muon polarization that remains remarkably resilient against applied magnetic fields---a behavior often interpreted as evidence of emergent sporadic spin dynamics. However, density functional theory calculations of muon stopping sites and their quadrupolar level-crossing resonance spectra suggest an alternative mechanism: a two-state model where the muon randomly hops between two nearby sites, eventually equilibrating across both on a microsecond timescale via quantum delocalization. These findings provide a microscopic explanation for the field-resilient muon polarization and indicate that such behavior may not always stem from intrinsic spin fluctuations, but can also arise from non-equilibrium muon dynamics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 低维和受挫磁体中的分数自旋激发通常与零星自旋涨落相关，正如在量子自旋液体、自旋冰和其他复杂磁态中观察到的那样。在本研究中，我们通过 μ 子光谱研究了 AgCuVO₄（一种具有竞争性链内相互作用的自旋 1/2 链化合物）调幅磁基态下的自旋动力学。我们的数据揭示了μ子极化的高斯衰变，它对施加的磁场仍然具有显着的弹性——这种行为通常被解释为新兴的零星自旋动力学的证据。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 低维和受挫磁体中的分数自旋激发通常与零星自旋涨落相关，正如在量子自旋液体、自旋冰和其他复杂磁态中观察到的那样。在本研究中，我们通过 μ 子光谱研究了 AgCuVO₄（一种具有竞争性链内相互作用的自旋 1/2 链化合物）调幅磁基态下的自旋动力学。我们的数据揭示了μ子极化的高斯衰变，它对施加的磁场仍然具有显着的弹性——这种行为通常被解释为新兴的零星自旋动力学的证据。然而，μ子停止位点及其四极能级交叉共振光谱的密度泛函理论计算提出了一种替代机制：双态模型，其中μ子在两个附近位点之间随机跳跃，最终通过量子离域在微秒时间尺度上平衡。这些发现为场弹性μ子极化提供了微观解释，并表明这种行为可能并不总是源于内在的自旋涨落，也可能源于非平衡μ子动力学。

full_list.title_en: Optimal active engines obey the thermodynamic Lorentz force law
full_list.title_zh: 最优主动发动机遵循热力学洛伦兹力定律
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.17087v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: What are the fundamental limitations for finite-time engines that extract work from active nonequilibrium systems, and what are the optimal protocols that approach them? We show that the finite-time work extraction for nonconservative overdamped Langevin systems may be rewritten as a Lorentz force Lagrangian action, with the kinetic term corresponding to a thermodynamic metric term that is an L₂-optimal transport cost for the time-dependent probability density, and the magnetic field coupling term corresponding to an effective quasistatic work extraction, proving that optimal protocols counterdiabatically steer the thermodynamic state trajectory to satisfy a Lorentz force law defined on thermodynamic state space. We utilize and reinterpret classic concepts from electromagnetism in the setting of cyclical nonequilibrium processes. We show that the housekeeping heat can be controlled to be arbitrarily close to zero by minimizing nonequilibrium fluctuations. It immediately follows from our results that the constant-velocity angle clamp protocol applied to the F₁ molecular motor in a recent experiment [T. Mishima et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 148402 (2025)] is in fact the globally optimal protocol: it produces zero housekeeping heat while simultaneously minimizing dissipation and maximizing work transduction.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从主动非平衡系统中提取功的有限时间引擎的基本限制是什么？接近它们的最佳协议是什么？我们证明，非保守过阻尼朗之万系统的有限时间功提取可以重写为洛伦兹力拉格朗日作用，其中动力学项对应于热力学度量项，该热力学度量项是时间相关概率密度的 L2 最优输运成本，而磁场耦合项对应于有效的准静态功提取，证明最优协议反向地引导热力学状态轨迹以满足热力学状态空间上定义的洛伦兹力定律。我们在循环非平衡过程的背景下利用并重新解释电磁学的经典概念。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Optimal active engines obey the thermodynamic Lorentz force law》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Pairing-channel reconstruction by Ising spin-orbit coupling in a multiorbital triangular-lattice model
full_list.title_zh: 多轨道三角晶格模型中伊辛自旋轨道耦合的配对通道重建
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21369v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ising spin-orbit coupling (SOC) is widely known for locking electronic spins and protecting superconductivity against in-plane paramagnetic pair breaking. Here we show that, in a correlated multiorbital system, Ising SOC can play a qualitatively different role: it reconstructs the hierarchy of spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing channels by reshaping the low-energy Fermi surfaces, orbital-spin coherence factors, and momentum-resolved scattering phase space. We study a noncentrosymmetric two-orbital triangular-lattice model with Rashba SOC, Ising SOC, and onsite SOC. We solve the pairing problem within a multiorbital random-phase-approximation framework. In the single-orbital limit, an E-representation state with a dominant S_z=0 component emerges only at relatively strong Ising SOC. Orbital degrees of freedom facilitate the stabilization of this pairing state at a smaller nominal Ising SOC strength and generate a broad competition between E and A₁ pairing channels. The E state can maintain the same S_z=0 triplet character, whereas the A₁ state becomes a fully gapped sign-changing splusminus superconductor. The latter also realizes a topologically nontrivial phase in the time-reversal-invariant weak-pairing regime, with a nonzero Z₂ index, Wilson-loop spectral flow, and boundary modes. Its topology is not carried by a single orbital pairing component, but emerges cooperatively from the dominant intra- and inter-orbital pairing components. These results establish a microscopic route by which Ising SOC and orbital hybridization can reconstruct interaction-driven superconductivity, producing both Ising-triplet and topological singlet-dominated phases in correlated non-centrosymmetric systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 伊辛自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 因锁定电子自旋和保护超导免受面内顺磁对断裂而广为人知。在这里，我们表明，在相关的多轨道系统中，伊辛 SOC 可以发挥性质不同的作用：它通过重塑低能费米面、轨道自旋相干因子和动量分辨散射相空间来重建自旋涨落介导的配对通道的层次结构。我们研究了具有 Rashba SOC、Ising SOC 和现场 SOC 的非中心对称双轨道三角晶格模型。我们在多轨道随机相位近似框架内解决配对问题。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 伊辛自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 因锁定电子自旋和保护超导免受面内顺磁对断裂而广为人知。在这里，我们表明，在相关的多轨道系统中，伊辛 SOC 可以发挥性质不同的作用：它通过重塑低能费米面、轨道自旋相干因子和动量分辨散射相空间来重建自旋涨落介导的配对通道的层次结构。我们研究了具有 Rashba SOC、Ising SOC 和现场 SOC 的非中心对称双轨道三角晶格模型。我们在多轨道随机相位近似框架内解决配对问题。在单轨道极限下，仅在相对较强的 Ising SOC 下才会出现具有 S_z=0 分量的 E 表示态。轨道自由度有助于在较小的标称 Ising SOC 强度下稳定该配对状态，并在 E 和 A₁ 配对通道之间产生广泛的竞争。 E态可以保持相同的S_z=0三重态特征，而A₁态则成为完全有隙的变号splusminus超导体。后者还在时间反转不变的弱配对机制中实现了拓扑非平凡相，具有非零 Z2 指数、威尔逊环谱流和边界模式。它的拓扑结构不是由单个轨道配对组件承载的，而是由占主导地位的轨道内和轨道间配对组件共同产生的。这些结果建立了一条微观途径，伊辛 SOC 和轨道杂化可以重建相互作用驱动的超导性，从而在相关非中心对称系统中产生伊辛三重态和拓扑单重态为主的相。

full_list.title_en: Parafermions in polarized ν=2/3 Fractional Quantum (Anomalous) Hall Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: 偏振 ν=2/3 分数量子（反常）霍尔异质结构中的平费米子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent experimental signatures of fractional Chern insulators in 2D quantum materials, we investigate the realization of mathbb Z₃ parafermion zero modes (PZMs) on edges of spin-polarized ν=2/3 fractional quantum Hall states which are proximitized by superconductors. Unlike the spin-unpolarized Halperin state, the polarized ν=2/3 edge contains counterpropagating electron and fractional quasihole modes, giving rise to a plethora of competing tunneling and pairing processes. We focus on the vicinity of the fixed point where these modes reorganize into decoupled charge and neutral sectors, with the neutral sector describing an emergent dipole degree of freedom. Using bosonization and renormalization group analysis, we lay out the parameter space in which the interedge dipole interactions gap the neutral sector to stabilize one dominant tunneling and one dominant pairing channel resulting in a double sine-Gordon model in the charge sector which supports Z₃ PZMs at domain walls. We discuss both clean and disordered systems. In clean systems this mechanism requires a certain degree of control of the interaction strength and range. In contrast, disorder can provide a more generic route: While short-ranged, edge-uncorrelated disorder % on the two edges suppresses the simultaneous pinning required for stable parafermion modes, when the disorder on the two edges is sufficiently correlated, as expected for smooth disorder potentials, the parameter regime hosting PZMs increases.
full_list.abstract_zh: 受二维量子材料中分数陈绝缘体最近实验特征的启发，我们研究了在邻近超导体的自旋极化 ν=2/3 分数量子霍尔态边缘上 mathbb Z₃ 平费米子零模式 (PZM) 的实现。与自旋非极化 Halperin 态不同，极化 ν=2/3 边缘包含反向传播电子和分数准空穴模式，从而产生大量竞争性隧道和配对过程。我们关注固定点附近，这些模式在此处重组为解耦电荷和中性部分，其中中性部分描述了新兴偶极子自由度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 受二维量子材料中分数陈绝缘体最近实验特征的启发，我们研究了在邻近超导体的自旋极化 ν=2/3 分数量子霍尔态边缘上 mathbb Z₃ 平费米子零模式 (PZM) 的实现。与自旋非极化 Halperin 态不同，极化 ν=2/3 边缘包含反向传播电子和分数准空穴模式，从而产生大量竞争性隧道和配对过程。我们关注固定点附近，这些模式在此处重组为解耦电荷和中性部分，其中中性部分描述了新兴偶极子自由度。使用玻色子化和重正化群分析，我们布置了参数空间，其中边缘偶极子相互作用使中性部分间隙，以稳定一个主要的隧道效应和一个主要的配对通道，从而在电荷部分中形成双正弦戈登模型，该模型在畴壁处支持 Z₃ PZM。我们讨论干净的系统和无序的系统。在清洁系统中，这种机制需要对相互作用的强度和范围进行一定程度的控制。相反，无序可以提供更通用的途径：虽然两个边缘上的短程、边缘不相关的无序%抑制了稳定平费米子模式所需的同时钉扎，但当两个边缘上的无序充分相关时，正如平滑无序势所预期的那样，托管PZM的参数范围会增加。

full_list.title_en: Pt-induced semimetallic transport and enhanced thermoelectric response in the half-Heusler alloy YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi
full_list.title_zh: 半霍斯勒合金 YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi 中 Pt 诱导的半金属输运和增强的热电响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Half-Heusler alloys provide a versatile platform for tuning electronic and thermal transport through chemical substitution. Here, we investigate the thermoelectric and magnetotransport properties of spark-plasma-sintered YNi₀.₅Pt₀.₅Bi. Partial substitution of Ni by Pt drives YNiBi toward semimetallic transport, characterized by hole-dominated conduction, a low Hall carrier concentration of mathrm1.9 × 10¹⁹ cm⁻³, and a sizeable nonsaturating magnetoresistance of 18% at 300 K under 14 T. Compared with YNiBi, Pt alloying increases the room-temperature Seebeck coefficient from approximately 90 to 130 mathrmμ V K⁻¹, while reducing the thermal conductivity to 3.15 mathrmW m⁻¹ K⁻¹. Single-parabolic-band analysis indicates an enhanced carrier effective mass, resulting in a room-temperature power factor of 13.7 mathrmμ W cm⁻¹ K⁻² and a figure of merit (zT= 0.13). First-principles calculations further show a Pt-induced closing of the electronic band gap and a low density of states near the Fermi level, consistent with the experimentally observed semimetal-like transport. These results demonstrate that Ni/Pt alloying provides an effective route for simultaneously tuning the electronic, magnetotransport, and thermoelectric properties of YNiBi-based half-Heusler compounds.

full_list.title_en: Quantum instanton approach to metastable collective spin systems: Numerical implementation and applications
full_list.title_zh: 亚稳态集体自旋系统的量子瞬子方法：数值实现和应用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21684v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Driven-dissipative collective spin systems can host several long-lived metastable states; rare switching between them governs slow relaxation and first-order dissipative phase transitions associated with changes in the dominant stationary state. In the companion Letter [arXiv:2604.15091], we introduced a quantum instanton framework based on exact quasiprobability dynamics to describe this switching and illustrated it with a minimal model possessing a simplifying symmetry. Here we develop its numerical implementation, combining collocation and shooting methods, and apply it to two microscopically motivated systems: the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model with purely collective dissipation and the cooperative resonance fluorescence with collective and local dissipation. By determining the leading exponential scaling of switching rates between metastable attractors, we predict the stationary magnetization, the first-order dissipative phase-transition point, and the exponential scaling of slow relaxation rates. These predictions agree with quantum master-equation calculations and an exact analytical result for the second model without dephasing. We also examine how the choice of quasiprobability representation affects numerical convergence and find that the alternative semiclassical Wigner approach, based on Gaussian truncation, has varying accuracy across models and parameter regimes. These results substantiate the framework's applicability to experimentally relevant collective spin systems with both collective and local dissipation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从动耗散集体自旋系统可以存在几种长期存在的亚稳态；它们之间的罕见切换控制着与主要稳态变化相关的缓慢弛豫和一阶耗散相变。在配套的信件 [arXiv:2604.15091] 中，我们引入了一个基于精确准概率动力学的量子瞬子框架来描述这种切换，并用具有简化对称性的最小模型来说明它。在这里，我们结合搭配和射击方法开发了其数值实现，并将其应用于两个微观激励系统：具有纯集体耗散的 Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick 模型和具有集体和局部耗散的协作共振荧光。

full_list.title_en: Quantum models with the Yang-Lee phase transition
full_list.title_zh: 具有 Yang-Lee 相变的量子模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.19732v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this article, we present four different 1+1D quantum models that realize the Yang-Lee (YL) phase transition under a deformation that preserves PT symmetry. These are the antiferromagnetic Ising spin chain in transverse and longitudinal magnetic fields, the massive Schwinger model, the Blume-Capel model, and the three-state quantum clock model. Using the state-operator correspondence, we identify the YL critical point, compute the scaling dimensions of the lowest operators in each model, and find perfect agreement with the exact results for the YL criticality in two dimensions. Using bosonization for the Schwinger model and the Polyakov-Hubbard transformation for the other models, we show that in all of these quantum models the YL critical point is described, as expected, by a massless bosonic field with an i φ³ interaction. In the quantum clock model, this critical field interacts with a massive bosonic field, and we identify the massless and massive states in the Hamiltonian spectrum. In addition, we numerically compute the two-point function of φ at the Yang-Lee critical point and show that it grows with distance, in agreement with theoretical expectations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了四种不同的 1+1D 量子模型，这些模型在保持 PT 对称性的变形下实现了 Yang-Lee (YL) 相变。它们是横向和纵向磁场中的反铁磁伊辛自旋链、大规模施温格模型、布卢姆-卡佩尔模型和三态量子钟模型。使用状态算子对应关系，我们识别 YL 临界点，计算每个模型中最低算子的缩放维度，并找到与二维 YL 临界点的精确结果完全一致的结果。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们提出了四种不同的 1+1D 量子模型，这些模型在保持 PT 对称性的变形下实现了 Yang-Lee (YL) 相变。它们是横向和纵向磁场中的反铁磁伊辛自旋链、大规模施温格模型、布卢姆-卡佩尔模型和三态量子钟模型。使用状态算子对应关系，我们识别 YL 临界点，计算每个模型中最低算子的缩放维度，并找到与二维 YL 临界点的精确结果完全一致的结果。使用 Schwinger 模型的玻色化和其他模型的 Polyakov-Hubbard 变换，我们表明，在所有这些量子模型中，正如预期的那样，YL 临界点由具有 i φ3 相互作用的无质量玻色子场描述。在量子钟模型中，这个临界场与巨大的玻色子场相互作用，我们识别了哈密顿谱中的无质量和质量状态。此外，我们数值计算了在 Yang-Lee 临界点处的 φ 的两点函数，并表明它随着距离的增加而增长，与理论预期一致。

full_list.title_en: Quantum oscillations in a solvable model of a Kondo insulator
full_list.title_zh: 近藤绝缘子可解模型中的量子振荡
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.20734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the effects of interactions on the low-energy density of states (SdH) and magnetization (dHvA) quantum oscillations (QOs) in a Kondo insulator. Toward this end we introduce a generalization of the periodic Anderson model with Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) interactions at each site that is exactly solvable in the large-N limit, where N is the number of flavors of the heavy f electrons. We show analytically and numerically that the insulating state remains stable in terms of spectrum, thermodynamics, and transport at low temperatures even for interaction strengths much larger than non-interacting band gap of the hybridization-gap insulator. We analytically derive generalizations of Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) formulae, distinct for the SdH and dHvA QOs, for the interacting insulator. We find that the SdH oscillation frequencies, F₀± δ F, corresponding to the conduction and valence band edges, can be weakly renormalized by interaction relative to their non-interacting values. In contrast, dHvA QO frequency F₀ is not renormalized by interactions, and remains the same as that for the non-interacting unhybridized bands. The QO amplitudes show a remarkable difference: the dHvA amplitude is essentially unaffected by interactions, while the SdH amplitude is strongly enhanced due to gap renormalization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了相互作用对近藤绝缘体中低能态密度(SdH)和磁化强度(dHvA)量子振荡(QO)的影响。为此，我们引入了在每个位点具有Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev （ SYK ）相互作用的周期Anderson模型的推广，该模型在大N极限中完全可解，其中N是重f电子的味道数。我们在分析和数值上表明，即使相互作用强度远大于杂交间隙绝缘体的非相互作用带隙，绝缘状态在低温下的光谱、热力学和传输方面仍然保持稳定。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了相互作用对近藤绝缘体中低能态密度(SdH)和磁化强度(dHvA)量子振荡(QO)的影响。为此，我们引入了在每个位点具有Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev （ SYK ）相互作用的周期Anderson模型的推广，该模型在大N极限中完全可解，其中N是重f电子的味道数。我们在分析和数值上表明，即使相互作用强度远大于杂交间隙绝缘体的非相互作用带隙，绝缘状态在低温下的光谱、热力学和传输方面仍然保持稳定。我们分析性地推导了Lifshitz-Kosevich （ LK ）公式的推广，对于相互作用的绝缘体， SdH和dHvA QO是不同的。我们发现，对应于传导带边缘和价带边缘的SdH振荡频率F恤± δ F ，相对于它们的非相互作用值，可以通过相互作用弱重整化。相比之下， dHvA QO频率F ”不通过相互作用重新归一化，并且与非相互作用的非杂交条带保持相同。QO振幅显示出显着差异： dHvA振幅基本上不受相互作用的影响，而SdH振幅由于间隙重整而强烈增强。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《近藤绝缘子可解模型中的量子振荡》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Sb-5p-mediated antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling in Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇
full_list.title_zh: Nd中Sb-5p介导的反平行Nd-Fe耦合Fe Sb
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.20883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying the antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling in the intermetallic 4f-3d-5p compound Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇ by means of high-field x-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) spectroscopy, complemented by magnetization measurements and density-functional-theory (DFT) calculations. This coupling is unexpected for intermetallics composed of light rare-earth and transition-metal elements. Sb M₄,₅-edge XMCD measurements indicate a clear spin polarization of Sb 5p states antiparallel to the Fe 3d moments. DFT calculations reveal the site-dependent character of the Sb moments and, together with the Fe-Sb antiparallel alignment seen by XMCD, identify a Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d hybridization pathway for the antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling. Pulsed-field XMCD reveals a field-induced spin reorientation through the evolution of the c-axis projections of the Nd and Fe moments. Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇, thus, provides a platform for exploring antiparallel rare-earth-transition-metal (R-T) coupling mediated by transition-metal 3d-ligand p-rare-earth 5d hybridization in light-R-T intermetallics with p-elements.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们通过高场x射线磁圆二色性（ XMCD ）光谱，以磁化测量和密度泛函理论（ DFT ）计算为补充，揭示了金属间化合物4f-3d-5p中反平行Nd-Fe耦合的微观机制。这种耦合对于由轻稀土和过渡金属元素组成的金属间化合物来说是出乎意料的。SbM ，边缘XMCD测量表明Sb5p状态的明显自旋极化与Fe3d矩反平行。DFT计算揭示了Sb矩的位点依赖性特征，并与XMCD观察到的Fe-Sb反平行比对相结合，确定了反平行Nd-Fe偶联的Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d杂交途径。

full_list.title_en: Standard and Bipolar Rectification in Tilted Periodically-Driven Quantum Systems
full_list.title_zh: 倾斜周期驱动量子系统中的标准和双极整流
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.20765v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Developing mechanisms to control transport in correlated quantum systems is essential for advancing quantum circuit technologies. In this work, we establish a rectification mechanism for both particle and energy flow in a fermionic system coupled to external baths, in the presence of a tilted potential modulated locally by a time-periodic drive. The drive generates particle and energy currents even in the absence of chemical or thermal bias between the baths. These drive-induced currents are enhanced at resonant frequencies at which avoided crossings occur in the Floquet quasienergy spectrum, reflecting the role of the Floquet states as intermediate channels for transport. Once a bias between the baths is introduced, the drive-induced current contribution can reinforce, compete with, or even cancel the bias-induced contribution. These effects enable rectification in the non-interacting regime, which we quantify via the rectification coefficient R. This coefficient measures the asymmetry between transport up the tilt (forward bias) and down the tilt (reverse bias). In addition to standard rectification, where transport is reduced under reverse bias, we identify a regime of bipolar rectification, in which the current flows only up the tilt regardless of the bias polarity. At the boundary between standard and bipolar regimes, the system achieves perfect rectification, corresponding to complete suppression of the reverse-bias current. In the presence of interactions between particles, the parameter region that supports bipolar rectification is enlarged and R can be enhanced by many orders of magnitude. Our results establish a rectification mechanism for particle and energy transport that can be experimentally realized in condensed matter and cold atom systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 开发控制相关量子系统中传输的机制对于推进量子电路技术至关重要。在这项工作中，我们在存在由时间周期驱动局部调制的倾斜电势的情况下，为与外部浴耦合的费米子系统中的粒子和能量流建立了整流机制。即使浴槽之间没有化学或热偏差，驱动器也会产生粒子和能量流。这些驱动感应电流在 Floquet 准能谱中避免发生交叉的谐振频率处增强，反映了 Floquet 态作为传输中间通道的作用。一旦在浴槽之间引入偏置，驱动感应电流贡献就可以增强、竞争甚至抵消偏置感应电流贡献。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 开发控制相关量子系统中传输的机制对于推进量子电路技术至关重要。在这项工作中，我们在存在由时间周期驱动局部调制的倾斜电势的情况下，为与外部浴耦合的费米子系统中的粒子和能量流建立了整流机制。即使浴槽之间没有化学或热偏差，驱动器也会产生粒子和能量流。这些驱动感应电流在 Floquet 准能谱中避免发生交叉的谐振频率处增强，反映了 Floquet 态作为传输中间通道的作用。一旦在浴槽之间引入偏置，驱动感应电流贡献就可以增强、竞争甚至抵消偏置感应电流贡献。这些效应可以在非相互作用状态下进行整流，我们通过整流系数 R 对其进行量化。该系数测量向上倾斜（前向偏置）和向下倾斜（反向偏置）传输之间的不对称性。除了在反向偏压下传输减少的标准整流之外，我们还确定了双极整流机制，其中无论偏置极性如何，电流仅沿倾斜方向流动。在标准和双极状态之间的边界处，系统实现了完美整流，对应于反向偏置电流的完全抑制。在粒子之间存在相互作用的情况下，支持双极整流的参数区域被扩大，并且 R 可以增强多个数量级。我们的研究结果建立了一种粒子和能量传输的整流机制，可以在凝聚态物质和冷原子系统中通过实验实现。

full_list.title_en: Superconductivity in a Bulk Moire Superlattice Material
full_list.title_zh: 块状莫尔超晶格材料中的超导性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.06622v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Moire materials provide a versatile platform realizing emergent electronic states arising from enhanced correlation due to flat bands. A variety of phenomena including superconductivity, low dimensional ferromagnetism, Mott insulating phase, and topological phenomena have been reported in such systems. To date, moire phenomena have been predominantly explored in artificially assembled low dimensional van der Waals structures, where relative twist and lattice alignment are controlled during device fabrication. Recently, intrinsically grown bulk moire crystals have emerged as a complementary materials platform, in which lattice mismatch between constituent layers generates a coherent moire superlattice throughout the bulk crystal. Here, we report the evidence of bulk superconductivity in single crystals of a recently reported bulk Moire material [Sr6TaS8]1+x[TaS2]8 at ambient pressure. The material exhibits a bulk superconducting transition at Tc = 2.5 K, evidenced consistently by electrical transport, magnetic susceptibility, and heat capacity measurements on single crystals. Structural characterization by X-ray diffraction and atomic resolution electron microscopy establishes the composite, incommensurate crystal structure and scanning tunnelling microscopy reveals a long-wavelength surface modulation due to the incommensurate structure. The observation of bulk superconductivity establishes superconductivity as an emergent phase in this intrinsically synthesized moire material and highlights bulk moire crystals as a promising platform for investigating correlated quantum phenomena beyond artificially assembled two-dimensional structures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 莫尔材料提供了一个多功能平台，实现因平带增强相关性而产生的紧急电子态。在此类系统中已经报道了各种现象，包括超导性、低维铁磁性、莫特绝缘相和拓扑现象。迄今为止，莫尔现象主要在人工组装的低维范德华结构中进行探索，其中相对扭曲和晶格排列在器件制造过程中受到控制。最近，本征生长的块状莫尔晶体已作为补充材料平台出现，其中组成层之间的晶格失配在整个块状晶体中产生相干莫尔超晶格。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《块状莫尔超晶格材料中的超导性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Symmetry and Quantum Geometry in Bloch Bands
full_list.title_zh: 布洛赫能带中的对称性和量子几何
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.21581v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum geometric quantities have featured heavily in the discussion of the properties of quantum systems in recent years. Among quantities most commonly discussed is the variance of Berry curvature and the integral of the trace of the quantum metric tensor. Despite their usefulness, it is known that they suffer from one significant complication: for a tight-binding model, the quantum geometric quantities depend not only on the parameters of the tight-binding model itself, but also the real space geometry of the tight-binding model, the so-called "orbital embedding". One explicitly geometry-independent quantity is therefore the minimal value of the quantum geometric quantity out of all possible real space geometries. In this work, we demonstrate that, if the tight-binding model is compatible with certain spatial symmetries, then the real space geometry that minimizes the variance of the Berry curvature or the integral of the trace of the quantum metric tensor must obey all those spatial symmetries. We further show that the statement is applicable to systems with magnetic translation symmetries and other composite symmetries, with implications for the quantum geometry of the Hofstadter model.
full_list.abstract_zh: 近年来，量子几何量在量子系统性质的讨论中占据重要地位。最常讨论的量是贝里曲率的方差和量子度量张量的迹的积分。尽管它们很有用，但众所周知，它们面临一个显着的复杂性：对于紧束缚模型，量子几何量不仅取决于紧束缚模型本身的参数，还取决于紧束缚模型的真实空间几何，即所谓的“轨道嵌入”。因此，一个明确的与几何无关的量是所有可能的真实空间几何中量子几何量的最小值。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，量子几何量在量子系统性质的讨论中占据重要地位。最常讨论的量是贝里曲率的方差和量子度量张量的迹的积分。尽管它们很有用，但众所周知，它们面临一个显着的复杂性：对于紧束缚模型，量子几何量不仅取决于紧束缚模型本身的参数，还取决于紧束缚模型的真实空间几何，即所谓的“轨道嵌入”。因此，一个明确的与几何无关的量是所有可能的真实空间几何中量子几何量的最小值。在这项工作中，我们证明，如果紧束缚模型与某些空间对称性兼容，那么最小化贝里曲率方差或量子度量张量迹积分的真实空间几何必须遵守所有这些空间对称性。我们进一步表明，该陈述适用于具有磁平移对称性和其他复合对称性的系统，并对霍夫施塔特模型的量子几何产生影响。

full_list.title_en: The Dry Ten Martini Problem at Criticality
full_list.title_zh: 干十马提尼问题的关键
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2112.06869v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We solve the dry ten martini problem (lean-verified this time) by showing that every labeled almost Mathieu gap is open for λ≠ 0 and every irrational frequency. In particular, we prove that the maximum logarithmic height of each labeled gap is non-decreasing in the coupling λ and extend an initial open seed gap for each gap label n from λin(0,λₙ) to all λ> 0. The non-decreasing property follows from restoring time-reversal symmetry to the almost Mathieu operator H by pairing it with its magnetic inverse barH. This allows us to express the logarithmic coupling derivative of the maximal gap height as the expectation value of a non-negative operator, yielding the required monotonicity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们通过证明每个标记的几乎 Mathieu 间隙对于 λ≠ 0 和每个无理频率都是开放的，来解决干十马提尼问题（这次经过精益验证）。特别是，我们证明每个标记间隙的最大对数高度在耦合 λ 中是不递减的，并将每个间隙标签 n 的初始开放种子间隙从 λin(0,λₙ) 扩展到所有 λ> 0。通过将时间反转对称性恢复到几乎 Mathieu 算子 H，通过将其与其磁逆 barH 配对，可以得出非递减性质。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过证明每个标记的几乎 Mathieu 间隙对于 λ≠ 0 和每个无理频率都是开放的，来解决干十马提尼问题（这次经过精益验证）。特别是，我们证明每个标记间隙的最大对数高度在耦合 λ 中是不递减的，并将每个间隙标签 n 的初始开放种子间隙从 λin(0,λₙ) 扩展到所有 λ> 0。通过将时间反转对称性恢复到几乎 Mathieu 算子 H，通过将其与其磁逆 barH 配对，可以得出非递减性质。这使我们能够将最大间隙高度的对数耦合导数表示为非负算子的期望值，从而产生所需的单调性。

full_list.title_en: Transdimensional Chern insulators in rhombohedral multilayer graphene superlattices
full_list.title_zh: 菱形多层石墨烯超晶格中的跨维陈绝缘体
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on lightly electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) in the "transdimensional" regime revealed anomalous Hall hysteresis under both perpendicular and in-plane magnetic fields, pointing to the emergence of transdimensional orbital magnetism in an interaction-driven "Fermi-lune" metal. Here we demonstrate that, by coupling to the moiré potential, this transdimensional orbital ferromagnetic metal can evolve into quantized Chern insulator phases in twisted RMG/hBN moiré superlattices. Using unrestricted Hartree-Fock calculations, we find that interaction-driven reconstruction isolates a spin-valley-polarized |C| = 1 Chern band, leading to a "transdimensional Chern insulator" (TDCI) state exhibiting both in-plane and out-of-plane orbital magnetizations. A minimal two-band model is introduced to describe the unique properties of TDCI, which unveils the intimate connection between non-reciprocal velocity and in-plane orbital magnetization. We further analyze the collective excitations of TDCIs, and identify soft charge and spin modes that may lead to density wave instabilities in certain cases. An in-plane magnetic field can harden the soft density-wave mode and may drive a transition from density-wave state to TDCI. Finally, when the |C| = 1 band is fractionally filled, the many-body ground state may be a fractional Chern insulator with broken rotation and mirror symmetries.
full_list.abstract_zh: 最近在“跨维度”状态下进行的轻电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG）实验揭示了垂直磁场和面内磁场下的异常霍尔磁滞，表明在相互作用驱动的“费米月形”金属中出现了跨维度轨道磁性。在这里，我们证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维轨道铁磁金属可以演化成扭曲 RMG/hBN 莫尔超晶格中的量子化陈绝缘体相。使用无限制的 Hartree-Fock 计算，我们发现相互作用驱动的重建隔离了自旋谷极化 |C| = 1 陈能带，导致“跨维陈绝缘体”(TDCI) 状态，表现出面内和面外轨道磁化强度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 最近在“跨维度”状态下进行的轻电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG）实验揭示了垂直磁场和面内磁场下的异常霍尔磁滞，表明在相互作用驱动的“费米月形”金属中出现了跨维度轨道磁性。在这里，我们证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维轨道铁磁金属可以演化成扭曲 RMG/hBN 莫尔超晶格中的量子化陈绝缘体相。使用无限制的 Hartree-Fock 计算，我们发现相互作用驱动的重建隔离了自旋谷极化 |C| = 1 陈能带，导致“跨维陈绝缘体”(TDCI) 状态，表现出面内和面外轨道磁化强度。引入最小二能带模型来描述 TDCI 的独特性质，揭示了非互易速度与面内轨道磁化强度之间的密切联系。我们进一步分析了 TDCI 的集体激发，并确定了在某些情况下可能导致密度波不稳定的软电荷和自旋模式。面内磁场可以硬化软密度波模式并且可以驱动从密度波状态到TDCI的转变。最后，当|C| = 1 能带被分数填充，多体基态可能是具有破缺旋转和镜像对称性的分数陈绝缘体。
full_list.summary: 最近在“跨维度”状态下进行的轻电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG）实验揭示了垂直磁场和面内磁场下的异常霍尔磁滞，表明在相互作用驱动的“费米月形”金属中出现了跨维度轨道磁性。在这里，我们证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维轨道铁磁金属可以演化成扭曲 RMG/hBN 莫尔超晶格中的量子化陈绝缘体相。使用无限制的 Hartree-Fock 计算，我们发现相互作用驱动的重建隔离了自旋谷极化 |C| = 1 陈能带，导致“跨维陈绝缘体”(TDCI) 状态，表现出面内和面外轨道磁化强度。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《菱形多层石墨烯超晶格中的跨维陈绝缘体》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Twist-controlled thermodynamic anomalies in bilayer q-state clock models
full_list.title_zh: 双层 q 态时钟模型中扭转控制的热力学异常
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twist has emerged as a geometric means of controlling collective behavior across a wide range of physical systems. Whether it can qualitatively reorganize the thermodynamic anomalies of discrete spin models, and how such changes relate to microscopic spin configurations, remains less explored. Here we demonstrate twist-controlled thermodynamic anomalies in ferromagnetic bilayer q-state clock models using Monte Carlo simulations. With sufficiently strong interlayer coupling, twisting changes the number and structure of specific-heat peaks: a single peak can split into two, or two peaks can merge into one, depending on the number of allowed spin orientations. These changes are nonmonotonic in twist angle and occur over narrower parameter ranges, or are absent, for the larger q values examined. The accompanying spin textures and vortex distributions suggest a physical picture in which moire modulation of the interlayer coupling reorganizes local spin alignment and topological defects. In a representative case, peak splitting coincides with nearly uniform spin regions arranged on the moire scale and a reduced vortex population. These findings identify twist as a control parameter for the collective thermal response of discrete spin systems and raise the possibility of modified phase-transition behavior, including the emergence or suppression of an intermediate Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless phase.
full_list.abstract_zh: Twist 已成为控制各种物理系统中集体行为的几何手段。它是否能够定性地重组离散自旋模型的热力学异常，以及这些变化与微观自旋构型的关系，仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们使用蒙特卡罗模拟演示了铁磁双层 q 态时钟模型中扭转控制的热力学异常。通过足够强的层间耦合，扭转会改变比热峰的数量和结构：单个峰可以分成两个，或者两个峰可以合并为一个，具体取决于允许的自旋方向的数量。这些变化在扭转角上是非单调的，并且在较窄的参数范围内发生，或者对于所检查的较大 q 值不存在。

full_list.title_en: Vision-Guided Closed-Loop Autonomous Navigation of Light-Driven Janus Microbots
full_list.title_zh: 光驱动 Janus 微型机器人的视觉引导闭环自主导航
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21222v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Artificial microbots capable of precise and autonomous navigation could provide versatile platforms for microscale transport, manipulation, and task execution in complex environments. However, reliable navigation becomes increasingly challenging at the micrometre scale, particularly when the surrounding environment changes dynamically. Here, we develop a vision-guided closed-loop navigation framework for light-driven cube-shaped hematite/TiO2 Janus microbots with a characteristic size of approximately 3 μm. Real-time visual localization using a custom-trained YOLOv11 object-detection model is integrated with discretized waypoint-based magnetic steering to enable precise navigation along complex prescribed trajectories, with more than 90% of the measured trajectory deviations remaining below 6 μm across the tested path geometries. The framework further enables arbitrary user-defined free-hand trajectories and autonomous navigation through a physically confined maze. In dynamically changing environments, A* path planning enables real-time path replanning while avoiding multiple independently swimming 5 μm spherical Janus micromotors. Finally, the microbot selectively captures multiple cargo particles and autonomously transports and delivers them to a predefined location while simultaneously avoiding dynamic obstacles. These results establish an integrated platform combining programmable trajectory control, autonomous path planning, real-time environmental adaptation, and task execution within a single light-driven Janus microbot system.
full_list.abstract_zh: 能够精确自主导航的人造微型机器人可以为复杂环境中的微型运输、操纵和任务执行提供多功能平台。然而，在微米尺度上可靠的导航变得越来越具有挑战性，特别是当周围环境动态变化时。在这里，我们为光驱动的立方体赤铁矿/TiO2 Janus 微型机器人开发了一种视觉引导闭环导航框架，其特征尺寸约为 3 μm。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 能够精确自主导航的人造微型机器人可以为复杂环境中的微型运输、操纵和任务执行提供多功能平台。然而，在微米尺度上可靠的导航变得越来越具有挑战性，特别是当周围环境动态变化时。在这里，我们为光驱动的立方体赤铁矿/TiO2 Janus 微型机器人开发了一种视觉引导闭环导航框架，其特征尺寸约为 3 μm。使用定制训练的 YOLOv11 对象检测模型进行的实时视觉定位与基于离散航点的磁力转向相集成，能够沿着复杂的规定轨迹进行精确导航，在测试的路径几何形状中，超过 90% 的测量轨迹偏差保持在 6 μm 以下。该框架进一步实现了任意用户定义的徒手轨迹和通过物理限制迷宫的自主导航。在动态变化的环境中，A* 路径规划可实现实时路径重新规划，同时避免多个独立游动的 5 μm 球形 Janus 微电机。最后，微型机器人有选择地捕获多个货物颗粒并自动运输并将它们运送到预定位置，同时避开动态障碍物。这些结果建立了一个集成平台，将可编程轨迹控制、自主路径规划、实时环境适应和任务执行结合在单个光驱动的 Janus 微型机器人系统中。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《低质量X射线二元多样性难题的统一解决方案：饱和磁力制动与辐射驱动的风》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A QED Functional Formulation of Relativistic Many-Body Perturbation Theory in Atoms
full_list.title_zh: 原子中相对论多体微扰理论的 QED 泛函公式
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We systematically derive relativistic many-body perturbation theory (RMBPT) from the two-particle irreducible effective action of quantum electrodynamics (QED) in the Furry picture, giving an organisational and diagrammatic framework for both correlation and radiative corrections in many-electron atoms. We further discuss that RMBPT is a well-defined subset of QED effects evaluated on a redefined vacuum, such that the interplay between correlation and radiative effects becomes transparent. We use this to derive QED corrections to the interelectronic interaction of atomic systems, yielding the transverse (frequency-dependent Breit) photon-exchange corrections, including retardation. Of those corrections, we numerically evaluate the first-order transverse photon-exchange corrections, which complement the conventional RMBPT based on the Dirac-Coulomb no-pair Hamiltonian.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们从 Furry 图片中量子电动力学 (QED) 的双粒子不可约有效作用系统地推导了相对论多体微扰理论 (RMBPT)，为多电子原子中的相关性和辐射校正提供了组织和图解框架。我们进一步讨论 MBPT 是在重新定义的真空上评估的 QED 效应的明确定义的子集，使得相关性和辐射效应之间的相互作用变得透明。我们用它来导出对原子系统电子间相互作用的 QED 校正，产生横向（频率相关的布赖特）光子交换校正，包括延迟。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们从 Furry 图片中量子电动力学 (QED) 的双粒子不可约有效作用系统地推导了相对论多体微扰理论 (RMBPT)，为多电子原子中的相关性和辐射校正提供了组织和图解框架。我们进一步讨论 MBPT 是在重新定义的真空上评估的 QED 效应的明确定义的子集，使得相关性和辐射效应之间的相互作用变得透明。我们用它来导出对原子系统电子间相互作用的 QED 校正，产生横向（频率相关的布赖特）光子交换校正，包括延迟。在这些校正中，我们对一阶横向光子交换校正进行了数值评估，它补充了基于狄拉克-库仑无对哈密顿量的传统 MBPT。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《原子中相对论多体微扰理论的 QED 泛函公式》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Aluminum wide-range EOS sensitivity in Z-pinch dynamic-hohlraum liner-foam impact and outgoing radiation
full_list.title_zh: Z 箍缩动态空腔衬垫泡沫冲击和传出辐射中铝的宽范围 EOS 灵敏度
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a Z-pinch dynamic hohlraum, an aluminum liner collides with a central foam and converts kinetic energy into radiation, and the liner-foam response depends on the aluminum equation of state (EOS). We construct a wide-range aluminum equation-of-state table from density functional theory (DFT) simulations over solid-liquid-plasma regions, denoted DFT-eos. Mixed deterministic-stochastic finite-temperature DFT (mDFT) gives the electron thermal contribution; quantum molecular dynamics (QMD) with classical calibration gives the ion part. We perform one-dimensional cylindrical radiation magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) simulations at a peak current of 50 MA and rise times of 220-300 ns on a single-layer light foam load. Opacity and electrical conductivity are fixed; only the liner Al EOS is changed between DFT-eos and the quotidian EOS (QEOS). Impact time and peak liner kinetic energy change little between the two tables. Larger differences appear in flight-segment density, the contact state at impact, and the time history of outgoing radiation power at the outer interface.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在 Z 箍缩动态空腔中，铝衬里与中心泡沫碰撞，将动能转化为辐射，衬里-泡沫响应取决于铝状态方程 (EOS)。我们根据固-液-等离子体区域的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 模拟构建了一个广泛的铝状态方程表，表示为 DFT-eos。混合确定性随机有限温度 DFT (mDFT) 给出了电子热贡献；量子分子动力学 (QMD) 与经典校准给出了离子部分。我们在单层轻质泡沫负载上以 50 MA 的峰值电流和 220-300 ns 的上升时间进行一维圆柱形辐射磁流体动力学 (MHD) 模拟。

full_list.title_en: Are E>B regions essential for particle injection in relativistic magnetic reconnection?
full_list.title_zh: E>B 区域对于相对论磁重联中的粒子注入至关重要吗？
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22118v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: During relativistic magnetic reconnection, X-points (E>B regions at vanishing guide field) have been proposed to play an essential role in injecting particles into the nonthermal population. Using fully kinetic particle-in-cell simulations at a range of magnetizations σ equiv B₀²/(4π n₀ mₑ c²) = 12--800, we study in detail how the particle energy gains up to the injection threshold γᵣₘ ᵢₙⱼ = σ/4 are partitioned into work done inside E>B regions (unmagnetized), within one gyration after exit (re-magnetizing), and at all other times (magnetized). The magnetized channel supplies the largest part of the energy gain for sim 95% of injected tracers at σ = 12 and sim 65% at σ = 800. Most of the tracers in this magnetized majority never enter an E>B region before injection. We also compare these injection shares with the earlier studies that proposed an essential role for E>B regions. We conclude that E>B regions are neither necessary for injection nor the dominant direct contributors to pre-injection work by injection share in two-dimensional, nonradiative pair-plasma reconnection at vanishing guide field.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在相对论磁重联过程中，X 点（引导场消失时的 E>B 区域）被认为在将粒子注入非热粒子群中发挥着重要作用。在一系列磁化强度 σ equal B₀²/(4π n₀ mₑ c²) = 12--800 下使用全动力学粒子内模拟，我们详细研究了粒子能量如何增益到注入阈值 γᵣₘ ᵢₙⱼ = σ/4，并在退出后的一个回转内划分为 E>B 区域（未磁化）内完成的功（重新磁化），以及在所有其他时间（磁化）。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在相对论磁重联过程中，X 点（引导场消失时的 E>B 区域）被认为在将粒子注入非热粒子群中发挥着重要作用。在一系列磁化强度 σ equal B₀²/(4π n₀ mₑ c²) = 12--800 下使用全动力学粒子内模拟，我们详细研究了粒子能量如何增益到注入阈值 γᵣₘ ᵢₙⱼ = σ/4，并在退出后的一个回转内划分为 E>B 区域（未磁化）内完成的功（重新磁化），以及在所有其他时间（磁化）。磁化通道为 sim 95% 的注入示踪剂（σ = 12）和 sim 65%（σ = 800）提供能量增益的最大部分。大多数磁化示踪剂在注入前从未进入 E>B 区域。我们还将这些注射份额与早期研究进行了比较，这些研究提出了 E>B 区域的重要作用。我们得出的结论是，E>B 区域既不是注入所必需的，也不是通过在消失导场处的二维非辐射对等离子体重连接中的注入份额对预注入工作的主要直接贡献者。

full_list.title_en: DST-Net: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal Network for Time Series Forecasting
full_list.title_zh: DST-Net：用于时间序列预测的分解时空网络
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.21123v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Series decomposition has emerged as a widely acknowledged paradigm in deep time series forecasting models. However, existing approaches predominantly employ a homogeneous modeling strategy for all subsequences, thereby overlooking the distinct inductive biases inherent in different components. We identify that the trend component exhibits dominant spatial coupling across channels but carries significant temporal redundancy, whereas the seasonal component is characterized by local temporal evolution but remains susceptible to attention distraction. To address this, we propose a novel disentangled architecture that tailors specific modeling strategies to align with the intrinsic properties of each component. For the trend branch, we design a Latent Graph Block, employing latent graph modeling to capture global topological dependencies and system-wide co-movements. Conversely, for the seasonal branch, we introduce a Gaussian Multi-scale Attention mechanism to mitigate attention distraction. By injecting learnable Gaussian priors, we impose structural constraints that compel the model to focus on multi-granular local contexts, effectively filtering out global noise and accurately capturing local evolutionary phases. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed model.
full_list.abstract_zh: 序列分解已成为深度时间序列预测模型中广泛认可的范例。然而，现有方法主要对所有子序列采用同质建模策略，从而忽略了不同组件中固有的不同归纳偏差。我们发现趋势成分表现出跨渠道的主导空间耦合，但具有显着的时间冗余，而季节性成分以局部时间演化为特征，但仍然容易受到注意力分散的影响。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的解缠结架构，该架构可以定制特定的建模策略以与每个组件的内在属性保持一致。对于趋势分支，我们设计了一个潜在图块，采用潜在图建模来捕获全局拓扑依赖性和系统范围的共同运动。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《DST-Net：用于时间序列预测的分解时空网络》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Learning Topology-Aware Representations for Mechanics-Relevant TPMS Metamaterials
full_list.title_zh: 学习力学相关 TPMS 超材料的拓扑感知表示
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.20684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning informative representations of mechanical Triply Periodic Minimal Surface (TPMS) metamaterials is important for mechanics analysis and structural design, yet existing methods have rarely explicitly supervised learned representations with information about global structural connectivity that is relevant to mechanical response. We propose a topology-aware representation learning framework that integrates persistent homology into a DMAE backbone to explicitly encode global structural connectivity. A persistence-guided masking strategy prioritizes patches associated with persistent topological features, while an auxiliary persistent-homology decoder encourages the latent representation to retain information about topological feature counts across connected components, tunnels, and voids. We evaluate the learned representations on two complementary TPMS datasets using family classification, mechanical-property classification, unsupervised clustering, and regression. Across the two datasets, our method demonstrates strong performance in both structural family and mechanical-property classification, improving family classification by up to 3.9% while achieving the best linear-probe performance. More notably, unsupervised property-clustering performance improves by up to 26.7% and 51.5% across the two datasets, while strong regression performance is retained with R²=0.993. These results establish persistent topology as an effective inductive bias for representation learning of complex three-dimensional mechanical metamaterials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 学习机械三周期最小表面（TPMS）超材料的信息表示对于力学分析和结构设计非常重要，但现有方法很少明确监督学习表示以及与机械响应相关的全局结构连接性信息。我们提出了一种拓扑感知表示学习框架，它将持久同源性集成到 DMAE 主干中，以显式编码全局结构连接性。持久性引导掩蔽策略优先考虑与持久拓扑特征相关的补丁，而辅助持久同源解码器则鼓励潜在表示保留有关跨连接组件、隧道和空隙的拓扑特征计数的信息。

full_list.title_en: Molecule-by-molecule nanoresolved picosecond Purcell-enhanced emission at room-temperature in hollow plasmonic nanocone metamaterials
full_list.title_zh: 中空等离子体纳米锥超材料中室温下逐分子纳米分辨皮秒珀塞尔增强发射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2506.15095v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nanoscale variations in the electromagnetic environment strongly influence quantum emission processes, yet direct quantitative visualization of these effects at the single-emitter level remains challenging. By combining single-molecule super-resolution microscopy with time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC), we read the local electromagnetic environment of each molecule from its position and its excited-state lifetime. Using wafer-scale arrays of hollow plasmonic nanocones, we map position-dependent variations in the local density of optical states (LDOS) along the nanocone axis. We observe pronounced LDOS gradients that evidence a shortening of the fluorescence lifetime from nanoseconds to few picoseconds. The measured decay rates along the nanocone axis with maximum value at the top ring, yielding a total spontaneous-emission rate enhancement of more than two orders of magnitude at the single-molecule level, reaching an enhancement of the total spontaneous-emission rate of up to two orders of magnitude at the single-molecule level, in agreement with numerical simulations. These results provide direct experimental access to three-dimensional electromagnetic landscapes and establish a non-perturbative platform for quantitative molecular nanosensing in complex photonic architectures. The approach opens new opportunities for engineered room-temperature photon sources, vectorial field sensing, and scalable integrated nanophotonic technologies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电磁环境中的纳米级变化强烈影响量子发射过程，但在单发射器水平上直接定量可视化这些效应仍然具有挑战性。通过将单分子超分辨率显微镜与时间相关单光子计数（TCSPC）相结合，我们从每个分子的位置和激发态寿命中读取其局部电磁环境。使用空心等离子体纳米锥的晶圆级阵列，我们绘制了沿纳米锥轴的局部光学态密度（LDOS）的位置相关变化。我们观察到明显的 LDOS 梯度，这证明荧光寿命从纳秒缩短到几皮秒。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电磁环境中的纳米级变化强烈影响量子发射过程，但在单发射器水平上直接定量可视化这些效应仍然具有挑战性。通过将单分子超分辨率显微镜与时间相关单光子计数（TCSPC）相结合，我们从每个分子的位置和激发态寿命中读取其局部电磁环境。使用空心等离子体纳米锥的晶圆级阵列，我们绘制了沿纳米锥轴的局部光学态密度（LDOS）的位置相关变化。我们观察到明显的 LDOS 梯度，这证明荧光寿命从纳秒缩短到几皮秒。沿纳米锥轴测量的衰减率在顶环处达到最大值，在单分子水平上产生了两个数量级以上的总自发发射率增强，在单分子水平上达到了高达两个数量级的总自发发射率增强，与数值模拟一致。这些结果提供了对三维电磁景观的直接实验途径，并为复杂光子结构中的定量分子纳米传感建立了非微扰平台。该方法为工程室温光子源、矢量场传感和可扩展的集成纳米光子技术带来了新的机遇。
full_list.summary: 电磁环境中的纳米级变化强烈影响量子发射过程，但在单发射器水平上直接定量可视化这些效应仍然具有挑战性。通过将单分子超分辨率显微镜与时间相关单光子计数（TCSPC）相结合，我们从每个分子的位置和激发态寿命中读取其局部电磁环境。使用空心等离子体纳米锥的晶圆级阵列，我们绘制了沿纳米锥轴的局部光学态密度（LDOS）的位置相关变化。我们观察到明显的 LDOS 梯度，这证明荧光寿命从纳秒缩短到几皮秒。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《中空等离子体纳米锥超材料中室温下逐分子纳米分辨皮秒珀塞尔增强发射》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: On magnetic-field consistency in the sideways force calculation of Phys. Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)
full_list.title_zh: 物理学侧向力计算中的磁场一致性研究。等离子 27, 012508 (2020)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.20644v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We examine the consistency of the equilibrium magnetic field B₀ used in the analytical calculation of the sideways wall force by A. A. Martynov and S. Yu. Medvedev [Phys. Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] and the subsequent reformulation presented in [Phys. Plasmas 27, 054702 (2020)]. In these attempts, the current density j₀ = nabla × B₀ must vanish in the vacuum regions adjacent to the wall, making B₀ curl-free as a complement to the natural nabla · B₀ = 0. Since the cited works incorporate selected toroidal corrections without explicitly specifying the corresponding differential operators, we test B₀ adopted in these models against Maxwell's equations using both toroidal and quasi-cylindrical formulations. We show that the divergence-free requirement is violated in the toroidal interpretation, while the curl-free condition is not satisfied in the quasi-cylindrical limit. The reformulation likewise fails to define a self-consistent equilibrium field with toroidal effects because the accompanying field corrections required for consistency with Maxwell's equations are not specified. Since the sideways force calculations are built upon these inconsistent field prescriptions, their analytical derivations are consequently compromised. The resulting arguments therefore cannot serve as a valid basis for revising either the earlier results established by D. V. Mironov and V. D. Pustovitov [Phys. Plasmas 24, 092508 (2017)] or those obtained within the single-harmonic analysis [Phys. Plasmas 22, 052502 (2015)].
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们检验了 A. A. Martynov 和 S. Yu 在侧壁力分析计算中使用的平衡磁场 B₀ 的一致性。梅德韦杰夫[物理学。 Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] 以及 [Phys. Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] 中提出的后续重新配方。等离子 27, 054702 (2020)]。在这些尝试中，电流密度 j₀ = nabla × B₀ 必须在邻近壁的真空区域中消失，使 B₀ 无卷曲，作为自然 nabla · B₀ = 0 的补充。

Plasmas 27, 012508 (2020)] 中提出的后续重新配方。等离子 27, 054702 (2020)]。在这些尝试中，电流密度 j₀ = nabla × B₀ 必须在邻近壁的真空区域中消失，使 B₀ 无卷曲，作为自然 nabla · B₀ = 0 的补充。由于引用的作品结合了选定的环形校正，而没有明确指定相应的微分算子，因此我们使用环形和准圆柱公式来测试这些模型中采用的 B₀ 与麦克斯韦方程组。我们表明，在环形解释中违反了无散度要求，而在准圆柱极限中不满足无旋度条件。重新表述同样无法定义具有环形效应的自洽平衡场，因为未指定与麦克斯韦方程组一致所需的伴随场校正。由于侧向力计算是建立在这些不一致的现场规定的基础上的，因此它们的分析推导会受到影响。因此，由此产生的论点不能作为修改 D. full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《物理学侧向力计算中的磁场一致性研究。等离子 27, 012508 (2020)》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Projected sensitivity of a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate comagnetometer to proton monopole-dipole interactions
full_list.title_zh: 旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚磁强计对质子单极-偶极相互作用的预计灵敏度
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Light spin-zero bosons with scalar and pseudoscalar couplings mediate a parity- and time-reversal-violating monopole-dipole interaction between unpolarized matter and polarized spins. For proton spins, the interaction has been probed directly only at ranges λ gtrsim 5 mm; below this range, laboratory limits are inferred from neutron-dominated nuclei through nuclear-spin models. We analyze a direct search with a single-domain ⁸⁷Rb spinor Bose-Einstein condensate in close proximity to a source mass. The F=1 and F=2 manifolds act as two co-located magnetometers that precess in opposite directions in a magnetic field but in the same direction under the exotic interaction. They thus form a natural comagnetometer, in which the sum of their precession angles suppresses field noise by a measured 44 dB and a weighted sum cancels the field altogether. Taking as a starting point the demonstrated magnetometry [Palacios et al. Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 119, e2115339119 (2022)] and comagnetometry [Gomez et al. Phys. Ref. Lett. 124, 170401 (2020)] performance of the ⁸⁷Rb single-domain spinor condensate at ICFO [Palacios et al. New J. Phys. 20, 053008 (2018)], we study the projected sensitivity as a function of source-mass geometry and in-progress improvements to atom loading methods, trap beam geometry, and magnetic environment. With an insulating bismuth germanate source mass with a spherical top, whose apex sits 50 μm below the center of the condensate, one week of acquisition would reach |gₛ^N gₚ^p|approx 2×10⁻²² with these upgrades and 3×10⁻²⁴ at the projection-noise limit (λ=100, μm, 95% C.L.). This is more than three and five orders of magnitude below existing laboratory limits. The improvement covers boson masses of 0.3-50 meV/c² after the upgrades and 0.09-70 meV/c² at the projection-noise limit.

full_list.title_en: Realization of a cavity-coupled Rydberg array
full_list.title_zh: 腔耦合里德伯阵列的实现
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.12152v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Scalable quantum computers and quantum networks require the combination of quantum processing nodes with efficient light-matter interfaces to distribute quantum information in local or long-distance quantum networks. Neutral-atom arrays have both been coupled to Rydberg states to enable high-fidelity quantum gates in universal processing architectures, and to optical cavities to realize interfaces to photons. However, combining these two capabilities and coupling atom arrays to highly excited Rydberg states in the mode of an optical cavity has been an outstanding challenge. Here we present a novel cavity-coupled Rydberg array that achieves this long-standing goal. We prepare, detect, and control individual atoms in a scalable optical tweezer array, couple them strongly to the optical mode of a high-finesse optical cavity and excite them in a controlled way to Rydberg states. We show that high-cooperativity coupling to an optical cavity -- demonstrated via the dispersive shift of the resonance of the cavity in presence of the atoms -- and strong Rydberg interactions -- demonstrated via the collective enhancement of Rydberg coupling in the atomic array -- can be achieved in our setup at the same spatial location. Our presented experimental platform opens the path to several new directions, including the realization of quantum network nodes, quantum simulation of long-range interacting, open quantum systems and photonic-state engineering leveraging high-fidelity Rydberg control.
full_list.abstract_zh: 可扩展的量子计算机和量子网络需要将量子处理节点与高效的光物质接口相结合，以在本地或长距离量子网络中分发量子信息。中性原子阵列已与里德伯态耦合，以在通用处理架构中实现高保真量子门，并与光学腔耦合以实现光子接口。然而，将这两种功能结合起来并以光学腔模式将原子阵列耦合到高度激发的里德堡态一直是一个突出的挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种新颖的腔耦合里德伯阵列，它实现了这一长期目标。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 可扩展的量子计算机和量子网络需要将量子处理节点与高效的光物质接口相结合，以在本地或长距离量子网络中分发量子信息。中性原子阵列已与里德伯态耦合，以在通用处理架构中实现高保真量子门，并与光学腔耦合以实现光子接口。然而，将这两种功能结合起来并以光学腔模式将原子阵列耦合到高度激发的里德堡态一直是一个突出的挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种新颖的腔耦合里德伯阵列，它实现了这一长期目标。我们在可扩展的光镊阵列中制备、检测和控制单个原子，将它们与高精细光学腔的光学模式强烈耦合，并以受控方式将它们激发到里德伯态。我们表明，与光学腔的高协同耦合（通过原子存在时腔共振的色散位移来证明）和强里德伯相互作用（通过原子阵列中里德伯耦合的集体增强来证明）可以在我们的装置中在相同的空间位置实现。我们提出的实验平台开辟了通往几个新方向的道路，包括量子网络节点的实现、远程交互的量子模拟、开放量子系统和利用高保真里德伯控制的光子态工程。
full_list.summary: 可扩展的量子计算机和量子网络需要将量子处理节点与高效的光物质接口相结合，以在本地或长距离量子网络中分发量子信息。中性原子阵列已与里德伯态耦合，以在通用处理架构中实现高保真量子门，并与光学腔耦合以实现光子接口。然而，将这两种功能结合起来并以光学腔模式将原子阵列耦合到高度激发的里德堡态一直是一个突出的挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种新颖的腔耦合里德伯阵列，它实现了这一长期目标。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《腔耦合里德伯阵列的实现》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Metastable nanoparticle cores amplify single-ion quantum level crossings
full_list.title_zh: 亚稳态纳米粒子核心放大单离子量子能级交叉
full_list.abstract: Classical size dispersion and experimental artefacts have long obscured the discrete quantum energy levels of individual magnetic sites in disordered nanoparticle ensembles. We report a field-periodic, phase-coherent switching resonance—robust under instrumental and processing controls—in the first-order reversal curve (FORC) response of biogenic magnetoferritin at 2 and 5 K. The period, μ₀ΔH = 11.9 ± 1.6 mT, is invariant and phase-coherent (p ≈ 10⁻³), and the resonance disappears above the blocking temperature. Cross-correlation shows the ridges tilt in proportion to the core remanence slope (ρ ≈ 0.78): the structure tracks the internal hysteretic state of the core, not the applied field, excluding instrumental and processing origins. The spacing gives an axial zero-field splitting D = 0.016 ± 0.002 K, identifying the active unit as an individual surface Fe³⁺ ion (S = 5/2), whose relaxation is exponentially amplified by cores thermally poised at their switching threshold (Γt ≈ 1). The resulting size–temperature window (TB/9.0 ≤ T ≤ TB) accounts for the thirty-year absence of resolved resonances in conventional magnetometry and predicts the geometric signature recovered in independent data at 6.9σ. This establishes a paradigm where macroscopic metastability serves as a quantum amplifier, enabling benchtop spectroscopy of single-ion quantum states in inherently disordered nanomaterials.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Mitigation of Common Mode Voltage in Multilevel Inverters for Linear and Non-linear Resistive Loads
full_list.title_zh: 线性和非线性电阻负载的多电平逆变器中共模电压的缓解
full_list.abstract: Multilevel inverters (MLIs) are popular due to their ability to provide voltage quality and reduce harmonics. However, common mode voltage (CMV) can undermine these advantages by affecting systems and electromagnetic compatibility. CMV can lead to electrical noise, Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), and potential damage to connected devices. To address this issue, a novel circuit is proposed in this paper aimed at effectively mitigating CMV in multilevel inverters when driving both linear and non-linear resistive loads. The modified circuit is designed to minimize CMV with experimental validation, and the results are graphically presented. The study encompasses a comprehensive analysis of CMV reduction and the effectiveness of the circuit modification in achieving significantly reduced CMV, contributing to improved system performance and reliability. The experimentation offers valuable insights in the field of power electronics, providing a practical solution for CMV reduction in multilevel inverter applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多电平逆变器 (MLI) 因其提供电压质量和减少谐波的能力而广受欢迎。然而，共模电压 (CMV) 可能会影响系统和电磁兼容性，从而削弱这些优势。 CMV 可能会导致电噪声、电磁干扰 (EMI) 以及对连接设备的潜在损坏。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种新颖的电路，旨在在驱动线性和非线性电阻负载时有效减轻多电平逆变器中的 CMV。修改后的电路旨在通过实验验证最大限度地减少 CMV，并以图形方式呈现结果。
